title: One of the benefits of AI gamedev is that you can even do it in the beach or at the park.
author: FutureLynx_
selftext:
You can just take your phone, and prompt your way as you are there under the sunshade.

As I was getting into gamedev years back, I took my C++ and C# books to the beach, and would read them there.

Even looked for game engines that worked better on mobile. Because I used to spend entire days at the beach.

replies.author: drnktgr
replies.body: Can confirm, I'm there right now

comments.author: Suspicious_Bet3623
comments.body:
I literally generate assets on my phone, at a farm which has no wifi or computers.  

But the best part is full control of the direction, not having to convince the boss, deliver specific features for investors, have staff turn their work to shit because they lost morale over their pet feature not being included, and so on.  You can just do it.

comments.author: nonsalantan
comments.body: how is that  can generate asset and codes but i cant input them right away from my phone, can i?

replies.author: DevLohk
replies.body: You can if you set it up on Git and connect your ai agent to it.

replies.author: HouseMysterious8172
replies.body: Asset and codes are generated, you only have to input prompt (text), can you?

comments.author: Am_Biyori
comments.body: Don't use AI much, but do lots of dev work on my Surface Pro 4. Trains, parks, waiting rooms, Pool side. Any where I go, Unity, VC, Inkscape and Notepad++ can go with me.

comments.author: SB_Down_Under
comments.body: I struggle on my laptop with one screen vs 3-4 screens at my desk.  I need a screen for prompting, a screen for file manager, a screen for web, a screen for app engine, and I still have lot of other things open.  So I'm always flicking between things, which is that much harder on a single screen.  I'd hate to think how hard it would be on a phone, I can't even type properly or nearly as quick as on a computer.

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: i only have one screen lol

replies.author: HouseMysterious8172
replies.body: Use voice control instead of typing?
